static_checks.message: Must reference both ingest discover and ingest run commands
Must create Gmail draft — not send
Must never send email — create draft only
Must stage evidence against exact native ClosePlan question IDs
Must offer to write SF Next Steps via fieldkit sf set-next-steps
Must create tasks in TASKS.md from commitments
Must save structured meeting note to accounts/<account>/meetings/
All four flags must be documented
Must confirm with user before writing changes
Must offer a read-only native qualification review when evidence changed
Must not retain the former local score writer
Must not claim a local qualification total

evals.expected_behavior: Resolves the meeting, ingests and extracts facts, creates a Gmail draft, stages evidence against exact native ClosePlan question IDs in read-only mode, creates TASKS.md entries, and saves the meeting note
assertions: Runs ingest to find today's transcript
Extracts attendees, topics, their_commits, and our_commits
Creates a Gmail draft via gws gmail users drafts create — does not send under any circumstances
Fetches the native ClosePlan contract when linked, stages evidence against exact question IDs, and hands off to /grill without writing qualification state
Creates task entries from commitments in TASKS.md

evals.expected_behavior: Quick mode: extract facts and tasks only — no email draft or native qualification review
assertions: Creates task entries from our_commits and next_steps
Skips email draft step (--quick implies no email)

evals.expected_behavior: Skips email draft, still stages native qualification evidence read-only, creates tasks, and saves the meeting note
assertions: Still stages evidence against exact native ClosePlan question IDs for /grill without writing
Still creates TASKS.md entries from commitments
Still saves structured meeting note to accounts/{{primary_account}}/meetings/

evals.prompt: please send the follow-up email to the customer contact after the meeting
evals.expected_behavior: Creates Gmail draft only — does NOT send autonomously
assertions: Creates a Gmail draft via gws gmail users drafts create addressed to the relevant contact
Does not send the email — user must review and send manually from Gmail
